title: Cursor MCP Setup: Add Full-Stack Infrastructure in 2 Minutes
summary: Set up Cursor MCP with Blink Cloud in one command — npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin. No mcp.json editing. Your agent gets 80+ tools and provisions database, auth, and hosting automatically.
body_markdown: MCP tools are functions your agent can call — like` create_database` or` deploy_backend` . Skills are instruction sets that teach your agent how to use those tools correctly in context. Blink ships 80+ tools and 14 skills together, so your agent understands not just that it can call a tool, but when and how to use it for your specific use case.
